labels.supportingSpan: There is disagreement over the exact elevation of Mount Everest because of variations in snow level, gravity deviation, and light refraction, among other factors. However, in 2020 China and Nepal jointly declared Mount Everest’s elevation to be 29,031.69 feet (8,848.86 meters), which was subsequently widely accepted.

labels.labelReason: Concrete morphological/explanatory description supplies descriptive substance beyond repeated proposition, though external observation provenance remains unspecified; explicit boundary for independent review.
labels.supportingSpan:
The blue whale (Balaenoptera musculus) is the largest animal on Earth, reaching up to 98 feet (30 meters) long and weighing 150 tons. As mammals, blue whale calves drink 50 to 150 gallons of their mother’s milk per day, gaining about 200 pounds daily.

Blue whales are blue-gray with lighter gray spots. They are baleen whales, possessing baleen plates instead of teeth, which they use to feed on krill.
